name: print-social-navy-hiring-graphic-designer-cover-with-3d-megaphone
title: Navy 'We Are Hiring! Graphic Designer' cover banner with a 3D blue megaphone and glass role list
whatItIs: A wide navy Facebook cover with a frosted glass panel holding 'We Are HIRING! GRAPHIC Designer' in mixed weights and blue, a blue pill tagline, perks line, a black and blue 3D megaphone, and a second glass panel listing open positions in outlined bars, plus CV email, WhatsApp number and an 'Apply now' button.
whatItMeans: Loud but polished; the megaphone literally announces the roles.
techniques: Use a 3D megaphone as the announcement symbol.
Split content into two glass panels: pitch and roles.
List roles in stacked outlined bars.
Mix weights and colours in the headline.

vocabulary.definition: A wide header image for a social profile.
